programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Trace
programme.desc: After being admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding, 11-month-old Chad Shelton dies. Investigators and scientists frantically search for a cause when others from the same house fall ill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Print Conviction
programme.desc: The 1996 investigation into 48-year-old Martha Hansen's murder is helped by a legal requirement that bars have video cameras installed on the premises.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication

programme.sub-title: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.
programme.sub-title: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Borderland / Mars: Red Dawn
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: Shooting Gallery: Asteroids and Comets / Galactic Visions: Alien Worlds

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.
programme.sub-title: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.
programme.sub-title: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls
programme.desc: Adore bliver presset til at vælge mellem sin eks og sin næste, hvilket gør en af dem vildt jaloux. En hot date bliver belønnet, og det skaber splid og et knust hjerte.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Liar, Liar, Chalet on Fire
programme.desc: En løgnedetektortest får alle i huset til at gå i panik og får et stærkt par til at miste tilliden i deres forhold, og Georgia finder endelig ud af sandheden om Callum og Paris.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Say Yes to the Next
programme.desc: Sandhedsceremonien skaber kaos i huset, og parrene skal beslutte, om de vælger deres eks, næste eller alene. En single stiller det store spørgsmål mens en anden forlader huset, fordi sandheden er for svær at bære.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Love, Next Love
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser ankommer til paradis for at finde deres næste kærlighed, velvidende at deres ekser vil spolere festen. Vil deres ekser komme på tværs af deres næste forhold eller blive det?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Serving Revenge
programme.desc: En overraskelse i Hemmelighedshullet giver Mark og Elena nyttige oplysninger om deres forhold. En ny eks kan ikke beslutte sig, om de medvirker for at finde kærlighed eller for at tage hævn. En eks sendes hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Put a Crush on You
programme.desc: Et spil 'telefon' fører til et opgør mellem Aubrey og Devin. En male-fest kører af sporet. Og den første date-pris udddeles.
programme.sub-title: I Put a Crush on You

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight
programme.desc: Cameron er fanget mellem sin eks og sin næste. Et par kan ikke blive enige om, hvorvidt de stadig er et par. En eks bliver sendt hjem.
programme.sub-title: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6
programme.desc: Devin udsætter sig selv for Maries vrede, da han kalder hende en 'sekser'. Billy forsøger at score Lexi. Og en kærlighedsdate bliver uddelt.
programme.sub-title: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Mother of All Secrets
programme.desc: En ny eks og et besøg fra mor sætter en kæp i hjulet for et spirende forhold. Marie kæmper med at være en 'sekser'. Singlerne slår sig sammen for at sende en eks hjem, der forhindrer en ven fra at finde sin næste partner.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exes Haunt These Fields
programme.desc: En eks ankommer på det værst mulige tidspunkt for at ødelægge et nyt forhold mellem en single og deres anden eks. Mark pifter tingene op med Aubrey. Billy is smaskforelsket i Lexi. En kærlighedsdate uddeles.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Coffey Run
programme.desc: Cameron skal i retten for forbrydelser begået mod hans ekser. Mark og Aubrey skal forholde sig til en uventet eks. Ens eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Want It That Way
programme.desc: Aubrey forsøger at blæse med mel i munden hvad angår hendes forhold til Mark og Coffey. Cameron kan ikke lade Ariana komme videre. Cirkus kommer til byen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue
programme.desc: Mechies nye forhold bliver sat på prøve, da en ny eks ankommer til huset. SInglerne lærer, at deres handlinger har konsekvenser ved en eliminering. Et hemmeligt forhold afsløres.
programme.sub-title: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Thruple Trouble
programme.desc: Aurbrey og Marks forhold når bunden. Devins nye kæreste sender Marie i torvene. Den sidste date udloves og en uventet gæst forstyrrer et par.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two for One Deal
programme.desc: Coffey ender midt i Mark og Aubreys brud. Mechie er splittet mellem sin eks og hans nye kæreste, hvilket gør Ariana anspændt. To ekser bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Show Me the Receipts
programme.desc: Nogle kendte og ukendte ansigter vender tilbage for at ryste op i tingene i huset. En løgnedetektortest tvinger nogle af singlerne til at vedstå, at de er nogle rodehoveder.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset skal forholde sig til resultatet af deres løgnedetektortest. Singlerne skal træffe den ultimative beslutning. Tager de hjem med deres deres eks, næste kæreste eller alene?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlerne og ekserne mødes for første gang siden den sidste ceremoni. Værterne Ashley Iaconetti og Jared Haibon fortæller os, hvilke par stadig er i hvedebrødsfasen, hvem der har slået op og hvem der har fundet sammen med deres eks igen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: War of Words
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage med otte singler, som håber at finde kærligheden på Bali, men i stedet erklærer Fatima og Nicole krig. Marty bliver betaget af Fatima, og Che og Max kan lide hinanden, men holder det, når eksene kommer?

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Med et slidt udstædningsrør og smadrede døre er hendes bil langt fra i tiptop stand.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Forholdet mellem Gio og Kaylen får alle op på dupperne, da Gio bager på Julia og alle andre piger i huset. Cam og Victoria har en nat, der ikke er værd at huske.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam og Eva-tema fører til jalousi, når parrene blandes. En kærlighedstrekant tager form, og der bliver ballade, når John, Tyler, Stephen og Gio prøver at forstå deres forvirrede hjerter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinlig udfordring får ekserne til at begynde at sprede rygter. Gio og Stephen får endelig sandheden at vide om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamle konflikter kommer op til overfladen og et stort skænderi fører til chok og tårer. Med kun to parceremonier tilbage prøver deltagerne desperat at lave en strategi for at vinde.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet, da den tiende og sidste parceremoni nærmer sig. Strategien fører gruppen til at tro på visse par, men Asaf er splittet mellem at følge sit hjerte eller sit team.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singler flytter ind i et hus i New Orleans og prøver at sætte 11 perfekte par sammen for at vinde en million dollar. Par falder pladask for hinanden og kærlighedstrekanter dannes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcoms opfører sig som en rigtig player og kommer i klemme mellem Diandra og Nurys. Keith og Alexis prøver at knuse hinandens hjerter ved at date andre.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love in Limbo
programme.desc: De stærkeste par i huset bliver angrebet, da folk begynder at stille spørgsmålstegn ved deres stærke bånd. Michael ryster huset, da han prøver at ødelægge flere forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmløs leg bliver enden på et par. Frustrationerne vokser mellem par, der knytter sig for meget til hinanden og singler, der har svært ved at skabe kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon spiller Tracy Flick, en handlekraftig elev, der vil være elevrådsformand på Carver High. Den populære lærer Jim McAllister (Broderick) vil afspore Tracys besatte overpræstation ved at rekruttere en oppositionskandidat.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Jerry Lewis spiller en genert, nærsynet kemilærer, som opdager en magisk eliksir, der kan forvandle ham til en charmerende og flot Romeo.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Christmas
programme.desc: En kvinde tager sin veninde med på et overraskende besøg hos sin datter på landet. Turen viser sig dog at være alt andet end fredelig med lokalbefolkningen, der skændes og afslører hinandens hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: Copycat
programme.desc: En detektiv fra San Francisco får hjælp fra en uvillig retsmedicinsk psykolog for at finde en seriemorder.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: En pengestærk jurastuderende tjener nemme penge som nattevagt i byens lighus. Men hans fredelige kirkegårdsvagter bliver en rædsel, da en seriemorder begynder at skabe kaos og efterlader spor, der peger på Martin!

programme.title: 20th Century Women
programme.desc: Dorothea Fields (Annette Bening) bor i Santa Barbara sammen med sin halvvoksne søn Jamie. I huset bor også eks-hippien William (Billy Crudup), som Dorothea håber kan være en rollemodel for hendes søn – men Jamie er ikke interesseret i ham.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: En tidligere straffet tager et job med at køre en lastbil tværs over landet. Den er imidlertid fyldt med våben, og han må kæmpe for at redde sin familie og overleve.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: Velkommen til Sin City - byen, som tiltrækker de seje, de korrupte og dem med et knust hjerte. Nogle kalder den mørk og hårdkogt, mens skurkagtige betjente, sexede kvinder og desperate selvtægtsmænd kalder den for deres hjem.

programme.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
programme.desc: En stuntkører overvejer at begå en forbrydelse for at forsørge sin familie, hvilket bringer ham på kollisionskurs med en politiker, der engang var politimand. Et krimidrama om det ubrydelige bånd mellem fædre og sønner.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Den midaldrende husmor Terrys liv bliver vendt på hovedet, da hendes mand pludselig flytter til Sverige med sin sekretær. Snart begynder Terry at føle sig tiltrukket af mandens bedste ven, den tidligere baseballstjerne Denny.

programme.title: Mus I Eget Hus
programme.desc: De uheldige brødre Lars og Ernie Smuntz er ikke særligt imponerede over det faldefærdige, gamle herskabshus, de arver, indtil de opdager, at deres forfaldne ejendom faktisk er flere millioner værd.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life in romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy, en kendt nyhedsvært i San Diego i 70'erne, mener ikke, at kvinder hører til i nyhedslokalet, så da Ron får en kvik og køn kvindelig kollega, er der dømt krig!

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 1941, syv krigsfanger flygter fra den frygtelige sovjetisk Gulag-lejr. Igennem 11 måneder kæmper de sig over 6.500 km fra Sibirien over den glohede Gobi-ørken i Mongoliet og videre over Himalaya bjergene.

programme.title: Swingers: Swingers
programme.desc: I denne morsomme indie-komedieklassiker, der startede karrieren for et enestående sæt skuespillere, sætter to venner sig for at omdanne moderne dating fra Los Angeles til Las Vegas.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Familien Bélier
programme.desc: 16-årige Paula er tolk for sine døvstumme forældre og bror på daglig basis, specielt når det gælder driften af familiens landbrug. Da Paulas musiklærer opdager den unge piges helt særlige talent for at synge, opfordrer han hende straks til at melde sig...

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: A string of murders targeting prominent law officials leaves a small Texas town gripped in fear and investigators in a race against time to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a woman is found brutally murdered in her workplace, a long list of suspects and a lack of DNA evidence means prosecutors must persuade a jury to send a man to prison based on circumstantial evidence alone.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: After a devoted mother and her two children vanish suddenly, investigators work to expose the truth behind why they never came home.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a brutal triple-homicide case with alleged ties to witchcraft heads to trial, questions about religious bias and the real motive-to-kill take center stage.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a white off-duty police officer, Amber Guyger, kills an unarmed black man, Botham Jean, in his own home in Dallas, racial tensions and calls for justice rise.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When two separate cases run cold for women who have been abducted and murdered, it takes the courage of a third unsuspecting victim, to unveil a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When an up-and-coming defense attorney is murdered in her office, her colleagues vow to seek justice and "make this right."

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: Small town detectives are frightened by what may come next after a young girl is brutally murdered in the woods; with a chance encounter and a digital trail, they must catch the child murderer at large.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a local deputy sheriff's pregnant daughter is shot and killed in her bed, the search for answers gets personal, as investigators suspect a killer close to home.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a loving wife and mother are found stabbed to death inside her home, a team of investigators dedicates eight years to finding her killer. Ultimately, an undercover sting operation uncovers a world of lies, betrayal, and terror.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When a 13-year-old girl goes missing and is found murdered, the virtual evidence she leaves behind leads to two shocking arrests.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When an Army Sergeant is gunned down at home on New Year's Eve, investigators are at a loss on who would harm the beloved family man, until fellow soldiers in his unit confess shocking secrets to solve his murder.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When an Ohio man emerges from a remote forest with a bullet lodged in his arm having survived a murder attempt, investigators uncover a deadly scheme to lure men with an online job posting only to kill them for financial gain.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: A relentless detective leaves no stone unturned until the entire truth behind a young woman's brutal death is exposed and everyone responsible for taking her life is brought to justice.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Mistaken Identity
programme.desc: A man hires a killer to bump off his wife, but instead, he kills another woman with the exact same name.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: A young German grifter moves to America, adopts various identities and kills many people along the way.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A young teen disappears from a small American town. Then several years later, he turns up, in Europe. But is it really him? And if not, what happened to the young teen?

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Skeleton in the Closet
programme.desc: A man is murdered by his cheating wife's lover, who had been living in their closet.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Who Done It?
programme.desc: A dead body discovered outside of a church leads to a world of sex, drugs, and Halloween pranks.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Counter Punch
programme.desc: A Washington man hires a sleazy amateur hitman to kill his wife. And when she turns the tables on her attacker, the gaping holes in their master plan are revealed.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Smoking Bun
programme.desc: A murdered Nebraska woman is connected to three men with hidden agendas—her best friend, her neighbor, and her ex-boyfriend. And a high-tech whodunit investigation ultimately reveals the killer left behind a smoking 'bun'.

programme.title: South Park: Go Gud Go XII!
programme.desc: Cartman nedfryser sig selv og vågner op 500 år ud i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Fattig og dum

programme.title: South Park: Tandfe-tingeltangel 2000
programme.desc: Cartman får 2 dollar af tandfeen, så drengene trækker så mange tænder som muligt ud i håb om at kunne købe et nyt videospillesystem.

programme.title: South Park: Op med Down-steroiden
programme.desc: Der afholdes 'Special Olympics' i South Park, og Cartman må overbevise komiteen om, at han er handicappet, så han kan slå Jimmy i den kommende begivenhed.

programme.title: South Park: Black Friday
programme.desc: Drengene forbereder sig på at slås mod andre kunder på den første dag i julehandlen.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert burde droppe fed mad

programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert burde droppe fed mad

programme.title: South Park: Deep Learning
programme.desc: Stan er chokeret, da skolen rystes af en snydeskandal.

programme.title: South Park: Problemet med en bæ
programme.desc: Mr. Hankeys stødende opførsel bringer ham i fare for at blive fyret som direktør for det årlige juleshow. Imens møder Stærk Kvinde og Rektor PK nogle helt nye udfordringer i deres forhold.

programme.title: South Park: Kongelig budding
programme.desc: Da den canadiske prinsesse bliver kidnappet til sit bryllup, bliver Ike sendt til Canada for at hjælpe med at finde hende. Hvilket uhyre har mon begået denne skrækkelige forbrydelse?

programme.title: South Park: Historien om Scrotie McBoogerballs
programme.desc: Butters får skylden - og derefter æren - efter drengene skriver en bog, som skulle være vildt grov, men som bliver hyldet som et mesterværk.

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison beslutter, at blive lesbisk, efter at hun igen er blevet svigtet. Drengene hyrer mexikanske immigranter til at lave deres hjemmeopgaver.

programme.title: South Park: Pinewood Derby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan opdager uforvarende warphastighed, så Jorden kan nu blive optaget i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en rumgangster truer med at ødelægge alting.

programme.title: South Park: Discount kabel-tv
programme.desc: Scott Malkinson er desperat efter at imponere den nye pige i klassen.

programme.title: South Park: Afleveringen af 'Ringenes Herre.'
programme.desc: Drengene tager på et mytisk eventyr for at aflevere deres kopi af 'Ringenes Herre' i videobutikken, og Butters ser sin første pornofilm.

programme.title: South Park: Chefs salte chokoladekugler
programme.desc: Da Chef ikke kan sælge sine karameller ved en besøgende filmfestival, ændrer han sin opskrift til salte chokoladekugler og digter en sang, som skal hjælpe ham med at sælge dem.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er stadig en beskidt sæk...
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto bliver skudt lige før, han afslører, hvem der er Cartmans far.
programme.sub-title: Cartmans mor er stadig en beskidt sæk...

programme.desc: Drengene stjæler en liste fra pigerne, som rangerer deres udseende fra den kønneste til den grimmeste. Opdagelsen påvirker forskellige drenge på forskellige måder.

programme.title: South Park: Det er jul i Canada
programme.desc: Kyles adoptivbror Ike bringes tilbage til Canada af sine biologiske forældre, da den nye canadiske statsminister bestemmer, at alle adoptivbørn fra Canada skal sendes hjem.

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin i rummet
programme.desc: Marvin er kommet tilbage! Han og drengene rejser jorden rundt på en mission for at samle mad, skarpt forfulgt af CIA og Sally Struthers.

programme.title: South Park: De smås krimiklub
programme.desc: Drengene starter en krimiklub, der skal opklare lokale forbrydelser, og det lykkes dem at finde en forsvunden dukke.

programme.title: South Park: Taberkant
programme.desc: Drengene er trætte af at spille baseball og udtænker en plan for at tabe den store play-off-kamp. Randy træner hårdt for at blive det største fulde fjols til hver kamp.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingeelsker
programme.desc: Da Barbrady tilkalder drengene for at hjælpe med at opklare sagen om den berygtede kyllingeelsker, bliver Cartman begejstret for sin nyfundne 'authoritah'.

programme.title: South Park: En elefant elsker med en gris

programme.sub-title: En elefant elsker med en gris

programme.desc: Da Butters bliver indfanget i en asiatisk territoriestrid opdager hans forældre, at han har flere personligheder, og beslutter sig for, at løsningen er at medicinere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek Vs. Craig
programme.desc: Drengene tvinger to af deres tøvende klassekammarater, Tweek og Craig, til en slåskamp i skolegården.

programme.title: South Park: Sponsoreret indhold
programme.desc: Jimmys integritet som nyhedsjournalist støder frontalt sammen med Rektor PK's ideologi.

programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rigdomme, der bliver plyndret af pirater i Somalien, så han tager klap for øjet og slæber slænget med til Afrika for at få en del af kagen.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
programme.desc: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
programme.desc: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Headband
programme.desc: Mistaken for a Fire Nation School student, the disguised Aang is forced to enroll in a Fire nation school. Aang's hair helped to disguise him better with his head band.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Painted Lady
programme.desc: When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sokka's Master
programme.desc: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Beach
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation to Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn much about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar and The Firelord
programme.desc: Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts - but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Runaway
programme.desc: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Puppetmaster
programme.desc: In a Halloween installment, the gang looks into strange disappearances in a spooky town. There, an old lady named Hama teaches Katara some secret Waterbending techniques.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Nightmares and Daydreams
programme.desc: On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion
programme.desc: It is the Day of Black Sun and the group meets up with the invasion force."The day has finally arrived and Aang is ready to take on the Fire Lord.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse
programme.desc: The eclipse has started and the gang only has a few minutes to get into an underground bunker and find and defeat Ozai.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King
programme.desc: Aang finds out that Ozai plans to burn down the Earth Kingdom with an airship fleet. He disappears during the night, having sleepwalked onto a mysterious moving island.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters
programme.desc: The gang find Iroh with June's help. Iroh suggests that Zuko challenge Azula for the position of Fire Lord, with Katara to help. The others decide to intercept the airship fleet.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno
programme.desc: Sokka, Toph and Suki begin destroying the airship fleet. Aang duels Ozai, but is soon overwhelmed because of his reluctance to kill him.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 4: Avatar Aang
programme.desc: Katara eventually defeats Azula by trapping her in ice, and heals Zuko. Sokka, Toph and Suki destroy the airship fleet.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Welcome to Republic City
programme.desc: Having mastered water, earth and fire, Avatar Korra is eager to begin her training in airbending, but trouble in Republic City interrupts her plans.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.desc: Da Sam og Freddie vinder konkurrencen for bedste skoleskab begge to, bliver de tvunget til at dele skab. Carly beder Spencer give hende timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie uddeler iCarly Awards til det bedste brugerindslag live i webshowet. Spencer hyrer europæiske badetøjsmodeler til at hjælpe med at lave priserne.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver at bevise, at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forklædning. Da Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer at overbevise hende om, at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 2
programme.desc: Da Carly opdager, at hendes "seje" kæreste Griffin samler på små nuttede tøjdyr, må hun beslutte, om hun kan klare at date en fyr med en tøjdyrssamling. Spencer hjælper Sam slippe af med sit mareridt.

programme.title: iCarly: Dingo-tyveri
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer tager hen i Dingo-studiet for at sige, hvad de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Vennekys
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til at afsløre over for Carly, at hun og Freddie kyssede i smug, konfronterer Carly dem om, hvorfor de ikke fortalte hende det. Og Spencer underviser fængselsfanger i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi laver mad
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie besejrer en berømt tv-kok i en madlavningskonkurrence, vil kokken ikke lave mad mere og nægter at komme ud af sit soveværelse. Spencer prøver at opfylde sin fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: En rektor med karakter
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin fyret, overtager miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og indfører strenge regler. Og Spencer hyrer en gammel rodeostjerne til at lære ham at ride på en mekanisk tyr.

programme.title: iCarly: Find en fyr til Carly
programme.desc: Så mange drenge dukker op til 'tag Carly med til fest'-konkurrencen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for at møde dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et ejendommeligt træningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernefiasko
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lave en musikvideo til en popstjernes comeback, opdager de, at popstjernen er ude af form og talentløs. Og Spencer opdager, at kvinden, han dater, er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg reddede dit liv
programme.desc: Da Freddie redder Carlys liv, forelsker Carly sig i ham. Sam og Spencer dyster mod hinanden i paintball-spillet Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts gamle flamme
programme.desc: Da slænget opdager, at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mand, som var forlovet med en smuk kvinde, sætter de sig for at forene det adskilte par.

programme.title: iCarly: Skønhedskonkurrencen
programme.desc: Sam afslører over for Carly og Freddie, at hun deltog i skønhedskonkurrencer som lille. Da hun finder ud af, at hendes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om at stille op imod hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Et usædvanligt webshow
programme.desc: Efter Sam pludselig bliver tvunget i fængsel, lover Carly og Freddie ikke at aflyse netshowet, fordi hendes far skal se det. Hun beder Spencer om hjælp, men det bliver svært, for han skal på date.

programme.title: iCarly: Rumvanvid
programme.desc: En pudsig milliardær beder Carly og hendes venner om at sende det første netshow fra rummet, så de bliver testet til en rumrejse. Imens besøger en mærkelig lille pige Spencer.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie flytter hjemmefra
programme.desc: Freddie beslutter at flytte ud af sin lejlighed efter hans mor gør ham flov. Carly, Sam og Freddie starter et firma, specialiserer sig i fotos af kæledyr.

programme.desc: Da en hedebølge rammer Seattle og strømmen går, kommer Spencer til undsætning med et norsk klimaanlæg.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere

programme.desc: Spencer forsøger at overraske Carly til hendes fødselsdag, men ender med at brænde hendes værelse ned. Men da forsikringen giver ham en stor check, får han mulighed for at gøre det godt igen.

programme.title: iCarly: iGør
programme.desc: Da en iCarly-fan frier til sin kæreste live i webshowet, bliver vennerne shanghajet til at komme til brylluppet. Men da bruden får kolde fødder, må Carly klarer ærterne.

programme.title: iCarly: iSælger penny-t-shirts
programme.desc: Vennerne kaster sig ud i at lave og sælge Penny-T-shits. Da salget går amok, hyrer Sam børn fra 4. til at hjælpe med at lave T-shirts. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om, hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: iLaver drengestreger
programme.desc: Da de andre driller Carly med, at hun aldrig har lavet fis, beder hun Spencer om hjælp med at lave fis med Sam og Freddie. Men da Spencer får smag for det, kan han ikke stoppe igen. Vennerne må finde en måde at stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: iSams mor
programme.desc: Efter et skænderi med sin mor flytter Sam ind hos Carly, som snart indser, at hun er en forfærdelig gæst. Freddie forfølges af en farlig forbryder, da han har fanget ham på fersk gerning på video.

programme.title: iCarly: iSkam på Nevel
programme.desc: Da en video af Nevel, der råber ad en lille pige, dukker op på nettet, begynder alle at hade ham. Efter de har fejret Nevels fald, går iCarly-vennerne i gang med at genoprette hans ære, da han tigger om deres hjælp.

programme.title: iCarly: iHyre en idiot
programme.desc: Vennerne beslutter at hyre en praktikant til webshowet. Carly og Sam hyrer en fyr, de synes er lækker, men han viser sig mest at være til besvær. Freddie må overbevise Carly og Sam om, at de skal af med ham.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Vennerne bruger natten på at afslutte deres projekter på Ridgeway til den årlige nat på skolen. Carly og Freddie får mistanke om, at Sam måske er vild med deres nye ven Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møder Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistænker, at hendes nye fyr, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så slænget planlægger en tur til Los Angeles for at afsløre ham til en fest, som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjælpen
programme.desc: Carly træder til for at løse et skænderi mellem Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for at få hjælp med hvert eneste skænderi. Nu hvor hun er involveret, hvordan kan Carly så trække sig?

programme.title: iCarly: Nærmest uudholdeligt
programme.desc: Mrs. Benson opdager Sam og Freddies forhold efter Gibby, som Sam nu håner, og planlægger at skille dem ad. Vil Carly kæmpe for Sam og Freddie, eller hjælpe Gibby med at skille dem ad?

programme.title: iCarly: Fuld af kærlighed
programme.desc: Carly siger, at Sam og Freddie skal prøve hinandens yndlingshobbier. Imens møder Spencer en gammel barnepige og inviterer hende ud på middag. Men bliver de sammen, efter de falder tilbage i deres gamle roller?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved at prøve at se smartere ud, end hun er. Og slænget prøver at finde et nyt sted at bo til T-Bo, efter han bliver smidt ud af Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynder at undersøge iCarly-slænget, efter de hacker ind i et sikkert netværk for at holde netfødselsdag for Carlys far. *Gæstestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Fedtekage-tyv
programme.desc: Slænget, minus Carly, tager Sam med til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men så kan Sam ikke komme ind i Amerika igen. Imens har Carly problemer i badet, mens hun gør sig klar til en date.

programme.title: iCarly: En øjenåbner
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet affærdiget i et interview om iCarly, prøver Freddie at vise sin kreative side ved at webcaste iCarly i 3D. Spencer hyrer en assistent, som han ikke har råd til at betale.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-brølere 2
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren, der spiller Rex on Victorious, vender tilbage som vært i et dybdeborende interview med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres vildt sjove bloopers/fraklip. *Gæstestjerne: Rex fra Victorious.

programme.desc: Donatello føler sig underlegen over for flugtobotten, men hans intellekt sættes på prøve, da Triceratonerne angriber!

programme.desc: Holdet må overvinde umulige odds for at få fat i det sidste stykke af sorthulsgeneratoren.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En knækket klan
programme.desc: Leonardo allierer sig i al hemmelighed med Karai og forvilder sig ud i større fare end han kunne have forestillet sig.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Kampen mod insekterne
programme.desc: Holdet kommer op imod Stockman-fluens nye insekthåndlangere, og Raph må mande sig op for at overvinde sin frygt for insekter og lede holdet.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 306

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 312

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 402

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1703

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Cengiz er i fuld sving med, at forberede alt det praktiske inden han og Stephanie rejser til Thailand, hvor han skal på knæ og fri.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 910
programme.desc: Linse er blevet kontaktet af en dame, der har reddet to hunde med hjem fra en ferie i udlandet. Det har desværre vist sig, at hundene er på listen over ulovlige hunderacer i Danmark.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 906
programme.desc: Linse og Didde tager på deres livs eventyr! De to Brygge-veninder skal hele vejen til Afrika og første stop på turen er Cape Town.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1109
